subject: Discovery recap + proposal: rotating 3-zone deep-dive windows
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Nolan <chris@frostbyte.ai>, Lina Martinez <lina@frostbyte.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + proposal: rotating 3-zone deep-dive windows

Hi Chris / Lina —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — great to learn more about Frostbyte's multi-region inference needs and the latency/cost tradeoffs you care about. Quick recap and proposed next step: 

Recap (high level)
- Goal: run a customer-facing demo + technical deep-dive that covers model variants, quantization tradeoffs, and a run-through of multi-region routing.
- Key constraints: EU data residency for logs, peak US daytime traffic with APAC support windows, primary P0 workload is low-latency chat; occasional batch embedding jobs.
- Success criteria for the deep-dive: 1) confirm sub-200ms median token latency in US; 2) validate fallback routing to cheaper quantized variants under load; 3) confirm audit/log shipping to your SIEM.

Next step: propose we schedule a 75-minute deep-dive that repeats weekly for three weeks in a rotating timeband so your engineering leads in US/EU/APAC can attend at least once in their local business hours. My proposal below aims to minimize calendar gymnastics while giving equivalent coverage across zones.

Proposed rotating windows (week 1->3 rotation)
- Window A (US-friendly): Tue 10:00–11:15 PT / Tue 13:00–14:15 ET / Tue 18:00–19:15 UTC
- Window B (EU-friendly): Wed 16:00–17:15 CET / Wed 07:00–08:15 PT / Wed 23:00–00:15 SGT
- Window C (APAC-friendly): Thu 09:30–10:45 SGT / Thu 01:30–02:45 PT / Thu 09:30–10:45 UTC

Practical notes:
- We rotate so each region has one session that aligns with local work hours across the 3-week pilot.
- Our team will prepare a tailored demo image and the MAP (mutual action plan) attached — we can surface any SSO/KMS questions up front.
- Attachments: Frostbyte-MAP-v1.pdf (high-level milestones), demo-agenda.md (proposed runbook and tech checkpoints).

Can you confirm which window (A/B/C) you'd prefer to start with, and who from your eng/security teams should be invited to each session? If helpful, here is my scheduling link: https://cal.com/kimberly/redwood-deepdive

Thanks — I can be flexible next week and can shift the first session based on your team's availability.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Attachments: Frostbyte-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf), demo-agenda.md (text/markdown)
From: Chris Nolan <chris@frostbyte.ai>

Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 11:45:00 +0100

Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear recap and the rotation idea — that actually solves a lot of the cross-team attendance friction. Quick answers: 

- Start with Window B for week 1 (EU-friendly) — that will let our EU infra and security leads join the first session and validate the residency/logs path.
- Attendees: myself (tech lead), Lina (product), and I want our security eng (Markus Berg, markus.berg@frostbyte.ai) on the invite for session 1.
- We prefer the sessions to be recorded and for the runbook to list the exact audit/log endpoints we should expect to see.

I can confirm Markus is available for Wed 16:00 CET next week. If you want to go ahead and tentatively book Window B for week 1 and we’ll confirm specifics after, that works. Also please CC Ben or whoever will do the kernel/ops demo.

Thanks,
Chris
CTO, Frostbyte
